prompt_section: ## 3. CHARACTER B — Backend Developer — exact final prompt
prompt_suffix: IDENTITY — the SAME approved person shown in reference #1 (Backend Developer master); preserve exactly, do NOT redesign: same face, short dark-brown undercut (#3A2B22) with slightly longer top, neat short stubble/beard, warm deeper skin (#D99A6C), dark technical zip jacket over a dark shirt, dark trousers, visible company lanyard, cyan/teal accent (#3BE8E0), taller broader build, calm technical methodical. He must remain the SAME recognizable character — only the POSE changes. STATE = READING: standing or lightly leaning, calmly reading an open technical book/manual held in his hands, a composed analytical break expression, relaxed shoulders. CAMERA: true 3/4 top-down ISOMETRIC, body turned about 30-45 degrees, slight top-down, feet aligned to the isometric floor direction — not front-facing, not profile, not a flat sticker. STYLE: the SAME fine pixel density, thin selective outlines, 3-tone shading and soft ambient occlusion as the IT/Dev floor (reference #2). LIGHTING: warm key light from the upper-left, softer darker shading lower-right, a subtle cyan monitor rim light, gentle ambient occlusion. Standalone single character, fully TRANSPARENT background — NO room, floor, desk, chair, shadow plate, scenery, UI, text, logo or watermark; full body with nothing cropped. REFERENCE PRIORITY: #1 approved character master controls IDENTITY and must be preserved exactly; #2 IT/Dev floor controls perspective, pixel density and lighting; #3 original office image controls the general game-art direction.
